verdict_scope: Authored desktop asset style, exported GLB integrity, topology, and preview readability only.

style_evidence.authoring: Matte faceted dark faces, pale MAT_Metal hard-edge geometry, and restrained cyan focal accents are authored into every canonical asset.

exported_line_geometry.contract: Each GLB contains one named __technical-lines__ mesh using MAT_Metal; Freestyle and Line Art are not export dependencies.

visual_review: The campus contact sheet and individual 768px proofs are non-black and numerically framed with positive margins.
Databricks has four descending left/right terrace pairs (eight slabs) around an unbridged narrow court.
Kaizen Metrics has four sawtooth roof teeth and a ten-sided faceted assistant lightwell.
Circular rims and bases use every top perimeter segment; the Workflow ramp remains intentionally interrupted by contract.

preview_decoded_rgba.interpretation: Eevee preview pixels are not fully byte deterministic across clean processes; generated image/container hashes and saved blend hashes must be treated as receipts, not equality gates.

limitations: Babylon runtime integration, exterior silhouette-weight edge pass, screen-stable line thickness across zoom, WebGL2 behavior, frame time, and load time were not tested in this asset-only lane.
Mobile parity is not an acceptance constraint for this desktop-first asset pass.
